besluite.rede: Carrying the inversion from the shared fronted 'Op Vrydag' into the second clause is standard, natural Afrikaans, and it keeps the time adverbial governing both clauses; the proposal is a lateral move that also loosens that link.

besluite.fout: 'hulle' could point to the two leaves held together or to Mieke's own leaves (plural 'haar eie'), so a Grade 4 reader may hesitate.
besluite.rede: 'die twee' names exactly the two leaves being compared, adds no fact and keeps the meaning.
